meta.title: AidBio | AI & Data Science for Life Sciences, Pharma and Agritech
meta.description: AidBio partners with academic labs, pharma R&D teams, and agritech companies to turn experimental and field data into predictive models, agentic AI workflows, and decisions you can act on.

hero.eyebrow: Data intelligence for life sciences, pharma and agriculture
hero.desc: AidBio turns research and field data into decisions — for university labs, biotech teams, and agritech operations.
hero.proof1: AI workflows grounded in real data
hero.proof2: Fluent in omics, agronomy and protein-interaction data

signal.lead: From field trials and climate-linked agronomic signal, to omics interpretation, biomarker discovery, and scientific reporting, AidBio delivers work that survives contact with a real lab, a real season, or a real peer review.

card2.label: Domain fit
card2.note: Agritech, biotech, pharma R&D, omics, translational analysis

card3.label: Delivery mode
card3.note: Clear milestones and maintainable code hand-off

card4.label: Philosophy
card4.note: No black-box hype without scientific accountability

solutions.lead: AidBio bridges deep biological domain knowledge with modern AI and data-engineering practice — producing systems that hold up in front of a principal investigator, a peer reviewer, or an agronomist who's seen too many black boxes.

card1.title: Machine Learning & Predictive Modeling
card1.body: Supervised learning, model selection, and validation for field, lab, and translational data — built for honest evaluation, not just an accuracy score.

card2.title: Agentic AI Workflows
card2.body: Domain-aware assistants and lightweight automation — reporting, retrieval, routine tasks — sized for a small scientific team, not an infrastructure team.

card3.title: Agritech & Climate Analytics
card3.body: Geospatial and weather-aware analytics for field trials and yield questions — built for real seasons, real sites, and imperfect sensors.

card4.title: Omics, Bioinformatics & Scientific Data Systems
card4.body: Support for multi-omics data — genomics, proteomics, and similar large biological datasets — plus reproducible analysis built toward a publication or a decision.

projects.lead: Alongside client work, AidBio ships open-source tools for agritech and life-science data. Try them now:

aidweather.body: Turns NASA POWER weather and solar data into clean, ready-to-use tables — for one point, a line across a map, or a whole region.

aid2go.body: Predicts protein function from one graph that links proteins, their interactions, and Gene Ontology terms — using graph neural networks over protein language-model embeddings.

aidviz.body: Publication figures and dashboards built from clean DataFrames — no data fetching, no model training, just plotting.

process.lead: Every engagement is scoped tightly, so your team spends time on the science and the decision — not on decoding a vague deliverable.

step1.title: Define & Align
step1.body: We clarify the question, the constraints, and what the data can actually support — before writing any code.

step2.title: Interrogate Data
step2.body: We clean and explore the data first, to separate real signal from noise.

step3.title: Build & Validate
step3.body: We build pipelines that give the same answer every time you run them.

step4.title: Ship & Transfer
step4.body: We hand off documented code your team can actually run and maintain.

founder.bio2: The approach is plain: honest models, code that reruns the same way twice, and results that stay useful after the meeting ends.
